photos.file: Dyscophus insularis, Ankarafantsika National Park, Madagascar 1.jpg
photos.desc: Dyscophus insularis A species of western dry deciduous forests, the "False" Tomato Frog is a close relative of the famous Red Tomato Frog (Dyscophus antongilii), which has a more confined distribution
